booking_contact_check.name: booking_contact_check
booking_contact_check.value: "booking"."customer_email" IS NOT NULL OR "booking"."customer_phone" IS NOT NULL OR "booking"."customer_user_id" IS NOT NULL

availability_exception_org_closed_day_ui.name: availability_exception_org_closed_day_uidx
availability_exception_org_closed_day_ui.where: "availability_exception"."service_id" IS NULL AND "availability_exception"."kind" = 'closed' AND "availability_exception"."start_time" IS NULL

availability_exception_range_check.name: availability_exception_range_check
availability_exception_range_check.value: ("availability_exception"."start_time" IS NULL AND "availability_exception"."end_time" IS NULL) OR "availability_exception"."start_time" < "availability_exception"."end_time"
